_comment: DRAFT (ADR 0014 / D41, not ratified) - confidential client used ONLY by the backend auth BFF (/api/auth/*) for the Resource Owner Password grant. directAccessGrantsEnabled is true on this client only; no browser flow, no service account. Uses the realm's built-in 'direct grant' flow (username, password, OTP required only when the user has an OTP credential). Does NOT carry an acr>=2 claim: spike 2026-11-02 (recette/spike-d41-direct-grant-acr.sh) shows Keycloak 26.3 always emits acr=1 on direct grant, so /api/admin/** and signatures stay on the redirect flow. No hardcoded acr mapper on purpose. Merge into the realm export (clients[]); secret from env KC_AUTH_BFF_SECRET, never committed. Audience mapper to be agreed with backend.

clients.name: Continuum - auth BFF (backend, direct grant)
clients.description: ADR 0014 / D41 draft. Server-side only (backend BFF); tokens never reach the browser.
